enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing steadily. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Remains still. Breathes deeply. Turns to right side. Kicks off blanket. Pulls blanket back. Remains asleep. Continues sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet face. Apply soap to face. Rinse face. Turn off tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit. Put down toothbrush. Wipe face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making tea with the kettle and toaster
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and butter. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press toaster lever down. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Take out mug and tea bag. Place tea bag in mug. Wait for kettle to boil. Pour hot water into mug. Remove toast from toaster. Spread butter on toast. Eat toast. Drink tea. Wash dishes. Dry dishes. Put away dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Packing university bag, checking phone for class timetable and unit updates
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open backpack. Place laptop in backpack. Place notebooks in backpack. Place pen case in backpack. Zip backpack. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open timetable app. Scroll through timetable. Check unit updates. Lock phone. Place phone in pocket.

Pick up backpack. Walk out of house. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card on reader. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk to campus entrance.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending Master of Education lectures and tutorials on campus
enriched_activities.desc: Enter lecture hall. Sit at desk. Take out notebook and pen. Listen to lecturer. Write notes. Raise hand. Ask question. Listen to response. Write more notes. Check phone. Open laptop. Type notes. Participate in group discussion. Take break. Walk to bathroom. Return to seat. Continue listening. Write summary.

enriched_activities.activity: Eating lunch on campus and reviewing lecture notes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to cafeteria. Buy sandwich. Pay cashier. Carry tray to table. Sit down. Eat sandwich. Open notebook. Read lecture notes. Highlight key points. Close notebook. Throw trash in bin. Return tray. Walk to library.

enriched_activities.activity: Attending afternoon classes, workshops and group study sessions on campus
enriched_activities.desc: Enter workshop room. Sit at group table. Introduce self to group. Discuss project. Take notes. Open laptop. Research online. Share findings. Listen to presentation. Ask questions. Work on group task. Present group findings. Listen to feedback. Pack up materials. Walk to next class. Sit in lecture. Listen. Write notes.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus stops. Get off bus. Walk home. Open door. Enter house. Close door. Lock door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner, washing up dishes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add ingredients. Stir. Cook. Turn off stove. Serve food. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Clear table. Wash dishes. Dry dishes. Put away dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Studying on computer, writing assignments and reading course materials under desk lamp
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Open assignment document. Type sentences. Read course material. Highlight text. Write notes. Check references. Edit assignment. Save document. Open browser. Search for sources. Read article. Take notes. Close browser. Continue typing. Save again. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV and browsing phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Change channel. Sit on couch. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media app. Scroll through feed. Like posts. Comment on post. Lock phone. Put down phone. Watch TV. Change channel again. Turn off TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing a light snack and packing lunch for tomorrow
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out bread and cheese. Close refrigerator. Open cupboard. Take out container. Make sandwich. Place sandwich in container. Close container. Place container in refrigerator. Take out yogurt. Open yogurt. Eat yogurt. Throw away yogurt cup. Wash hands.

Walk to bedroom. Turn on desk lamp. Pick up book. Read book. Turn off desk lamp. Lie down on bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe deeply. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Fall asleep. Continue sleeping.
